statement: No correct circuit of fan-in-2 AND/OR gates and at most 2 NOT gates has fewer than base gates on: triangle of triples (base 6), Pasch (8), star of 3 triples (6), tri4 (6), q4 (7), Fano minus 2 lines (n = 7, base 10); exact SAT at s = base - 1 is UNSAT. With unbounded NOT gates also UNSAT on the first five.

The general witness count |witness(empty)| >= base holds on 2,400/2,400 SAT-enumerated correct circuits with exactly 2 NOT gates (no NOT of NOT) and on 2,700/2,700 with exactly 3 NOT gates, on tri3, star3, tri4, q4 at s = base+3 .. base+5. Not adversarial (SAT order).

With exactly 2 NOT gates, neither feeding the other, the minimum circuit size is base + 3 on tri3, star3 and tri4 (UNSAT at base + 1, base + 2) and above base + 2 on q4 and Pasch: on these systems NOT gates cost gates, never save them.

statement: No correct circuit with at most 2 NOT gates has fewer than base gates on K4-triples (n = 7, 6 triples, base 12; UNSAT at s = 11, 1,933 s) or on the Fano plane minus one line (n = 7, base 12; UNSAT at s = 11, 1,492 s). Uses --sb (co-lexicographic gate order on independent adjacent gates, the standard exact-synthesis symmetry break).

SAT with the witness count as a constraint (--wbelow: at most base - 1 gates satisfy D9) finds no correct circuit with at most 2 NOT gates and witness count below base on: tri3 at s = 8, 10, 12; star3 at s = 8, 10, 12; star44 (the system of the t = 4 break) at s = 10, 11; nor with at most 3 NOT gates on star44 at s = 10. Control: with 4 NOT gates star44 at s = 10 is SAT (witness 5 < base 6), reproducing general_count_below_base_min.

statement: No correct circuit with at most 4 NOT gates has fewer than base gates on K4-triples (n = 7, base 12): s = 11, t <= 4 is UNSAT (2,314 s, --sb).

On star44 (the system of the t = 4 break, base 6) no correct circuit with at most 2 NOT gates has witness count below base at any size s = 10..14, and none with at most 3 NOT gates at s = 10, 11 (s = 12 timed out at 2,400 s); with 4 NOT gates s = 10 suffices. Also none at t <= 2 on Pasch s = 10, q4 s = 9. So the t = 4 break does not shrink to t = 2 up to 14 gates.

S3(b) FlipClasses.count, exact SAT (--fclasses base-1, --sb): no correct circuit with at most 9 NOT gates has fewer than base flip classes on two triples (base 4) at s = 4..9, star44 (base 6) at s = 6..8, star of three triples (base 6) at s = 6..9; also triangle of triples s = 8, t <= 4. Controls: tri3 s = 6 t = 0 SAT at 6 classes, UNSAT at 5.
